answer: Chasing fakes after they collect is a losing game. Qualified pothole repair gang leader badge with repair gangs standing blocks them at the entrance: a badge gangs renew after patch audits, which puts the grove of a farm on the table before it earns anything at all. No reward is issued before the check, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the basalt is that the attacker learns the price before the first coin, not after. A single proof may be pocket change, but a hundred of them drain the farm's purse in a straight line while verification stays almost free; the trellis is that drain.
